provenance: Agent source review on 2026-11-02. This agent implemented the new Shared unpacking and binding proofs, not the Given chapters or their Unique formalization. It reread both Given chapters, required dependent units, the selected Unique definitions and theorem/example statements, relevant setup/helper declarations, and the review policy. rationale: WellFormed.live_iff_allocated quantifies over arbitrary classes, state and object with only WellFormed as premise; it concludes Live state object iff Allocated state object. This is exactly the stated result, not restricted to reachable executions. Both predicates and the older-target acyclicity condition that supports it are defined in given.well_formed. The explanatory absence of missing reachable objects is the forward implication.
limitations: Correspondence review compares prose, mathematics, definitions and theorem/example statements; Lean proof validity and command results are separate checks. Listing relevant source-context snapshots records definitions and assumptions consulted, not an audit of every tactic or unrelated declaration.

Finite-map notation uses the documented distinct-key and well-formedness conventions. Raw Lean list representations also admit malformed values; no functional-lookup or preservation claim is made for those outside the stated premises.
